cs.t: At work I have one of the dell curved ultra wide monitors. ( https://amzn.to/36tH96T ). Love it. I used to have multiple monitors, but many years ago I made the decision that it works better for me to completely control windowing concerns in software. (I use the i3 tiling manager for this.) I have seen no reason to change.
cs.th: Ask HN: Ultrawide monitors, what's your experience been like?
